## Context / Problem
Five Python unit-test paths contain five audited prose blocks with repeated mechanism narration or historical detail. Scope was revalidated against `origin/main@50716c9aed87479e4347a4daf084c9778c8793f7`. The old `test_terraform_plan_review_tools.py:178-183` citation is stale: those current lines are executable assertions and are not editable; the intended unchanged prose is now the full-line block immediately before `_CaptureRunner`.

## Approach
Edit only the five stable-ID blocks below. Capture immutable before/final blobs for every owned path and parse both with `ast.parse(..., type_comments=True)`. On comparison copies, remove only an allowlisted leading `Expr(Constant(str))` from a `Module`, `ClassDef`, `FunctionDef`, or `AsyncFunctionDef`; normalize only `ast.TypeIgnore.lineno`; require normalized AST equality.

Tokenize comments by enclosing symbol plus the next unchanged executable anchor. Reject every changed inline comment, directive, or non-allowlisted full-line block. Preserve runtime strings, imports, decorators, annotations, assertions, subprocess arguments, test fixtures/data, and exact shebang/directive physical lines. Adjacent blank-line normalization is allowed only around an edited block.

## Stable block allowlist
- `tests/unit/evals/test_plan_replay_corpus.py`
  - `D:<module>`
- `tests/unit/io/test_git_counts_helper.py`
  - `D:<module>`
- `tests/unit/test_worktree_python_pin.py`
  - `D:<module>`
- `tests/unit/test_write_lock_busy_probe_7084.py`
  - `D:<module>`
- `tests/unit/workflow/test_terraform_plan_review_tools.py`
  - `C:<module>:before:class _CaptureRunner`

`D:<module>` means the true leading module docstring. `C:<scope>:before:<code>` means the maximal contiguous full-line comment block immediately before that unchanged code anchor. No other comment/docstring is editable.

## Preserved contracts and consumers
- Replay-corpus recovery still walks historical git objects, reconstructs only through the review timestamp, accepts current and legacy material-fingerprint generations, and performs no LLM/network call.
- `TrackerBuilder` and `_ctx` from `test_plan_replay_corpus.py` are imported by `tests/unit/evals/test_plan_replay_parity.py`; that consumer is included in focused pytest and all executable helper code remains exact.
- Git commit-count behavior retains bounded transient retry and diagnostic `RuntimeError` with git stderr instead of an integer-conversion `ValueError`.
- Worktree provisioning remains pinned to the CI-tested interpreter value single-sourced in `.github/python-version.txt`.
- The write-lock busy probe remains nonblocking across both acquisition legs, releases partial acquisition, leaves no lock, and fails open on unexpected errors.
- The Terraform Pass-1 finder receives criterion-routed tools through `RunRequest.extra_tools` via `terraform_seam.pass1_tool_hook`; the static assertions formerly at lines 178-183 and every other executable line remain untouched.
- These files are otherwise direct pytest inputs. No `__doc__`, `inspect.getdoc`, or pydoc consumer was found at the pinned base.

Preserve these complete directive-bearing physical lines byte-for-byte:

```python
    def preflight(self) -> None:  # pragma: no cover — protocol completeness
if __name__ == "__main__":  # pragma: no cover
```

All other inline comments also remain unchanged.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Changes are limited to the five stable-ID blocks and adjacent blank lines; normalized-AST and token/comment comparisons pass for every owned path.
- [ ] Every edited block is shorter and preserves its listed constraint/consumer; historical citations, repetition, and ornamental emphasis are removed.
- [ ] Current executable lines 178-183 of `test_terraform_plan_review_tools.py` remain byte/AST exact; only the comment block anchored before `_CaptureRunner` is editable in that file.
- [ ] A reviewer who did not author the edits posts a leaf-linked TSV with one row per edited block: `stable_block_id<TAB>before_citation<TAB>final_citation<TAB>preserved_contract_or_consumer<TAB>directives_exact<TAB>before_words<TAB>after_words<TAB>semantic-preservation<TAB>bloat-removal<TAB>reviewer_session`.
- [ ] All five rows cite immutable blobs and record `directives_exact=PASS`, `semantic-preservation=PASS`, and `bloat-removal=PASS`; missing/failing rows block closure.
- [ ] Focused pytest (including the replay-corpus consumer), scoped Ruff check/format, comment hygiene, path-scoped `git diff --check`, and worktree-venv `make verify` pass.

## Verification
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/unit/evals/test_plan_replay_corpus.py tests/unit/evals/test_plan_replay_parity.py tests/unit/io/test_git_counts_helper.py tests/unit/test_worktree_python_pin.py tests/unit/test_write_lock_busy_probe_7084.py tests/unit/workflow/test_terraform_plan_review_tools.py`
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" .venv/bin/ruff check tests/unit/evals/test_plan_replay_corpus.py tests/unit/io/test_git_counts_helper.py tests/unit/test_worktree_python_pin.py tests/unit/test_write_lock_busy_probe_7084.py tests/unit/workflow/test_terraform_plan_review_tools.py`
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" .venv/bin/ruff format --check tests/unit/evals/test_plan_replay_corpus.py tests/unit/io/test_git_counts_helper.py tests/unit/test_worktree_python_pin.py tests/unit/test_write_lock_busy_probe_7084.py tests/unit/workflow/test_terraform_plan_review_tools.py`
